task_summary: Grounded BukSU CMS-V2 UI workflows in capstone manuscript Chapters 3-5 and Appendix C: created the reusable role-user-stories-and-pain-points skill (.agents/skills/role-user-stories-and-pain-points/), added role quick-actions/guidance banners across Student, Faculty, Instructor, Capstone 1, Submissions, and Document Management pages, conducted real-person multi-role browser navigation, and resolved 6 live defects (flex shrink-0 text-squeeze/clipping, Capstone 1 submissions object/chapter key mismatch, 15%/25% similarity copy alignment, faculty cross-view RBAC 403s + stale revision deduplication + duplicate faculty workload rows, student directory redirect button, and Router-safe SPA links).
verified: Targeted client Vitest suites: 7 files, 49/49 tests passed (Capstone1CollapsibleSections, MyProjectPage, StudentDashboard, FacultyDashboard, InstructorDashboard, TemplateManagementPage, ProjectSubmissionsPage)
Targeted server integration suite tests/integration/dashboard.test.js: 15/15 tests passed
Scoped ESLint across 10 modified JS/JSX files: 0 errors (1 pre-existing warning in dashboard.service.js:127); Vite build: 4865 modules built in 34.60s

Live multi-role browser walkthrough (student, adviser/panelist, instructor on http://localhost:43211) + Playwright 4-viewport Light/Dark audit (Desktop 1440x900 & Mobile 390x844): zero horizontal overflow, zero clipped buttons, zero Vite overlays
lessons_learned: Lesson learned: Pairing sm:flex-row/lg:flex-row with shrink-0 on multi-button shortcut strips inside DashboardLayout (~874px content column) crushes left-hand prose to 1 char per line and clips right buttons; useProjectSubmissions also returns { submissions, pagination } with numeric chapter in production whereas mocks returned arrays with chapterNumber; historical submission versions remain in adviser review queues unless deduplicated per (projectId, type, chapter).

Prevention runbook/checklist: Stack multi-button guide banners vertically (flex flex-col gap-3) above wrapping flex-wrap button rows without shrink-0, unwrap both array and { submissions } API shapes with s.chapter ?? s.chapterNumber, deduplicate latest submission versions before status filtering, and run real-person live browser walkthroughs after unit tests.
